summary: Sigma Lithium Corp filed a Form 6-K containing a Notice of Annual Meeting and Management Information Circular for its June 30, 2026 annual meeting. The agenda includes receiving 2025 financial statements, fixing board size at five, electing directors, and appointing auditors. No special-situation corporate event is announced. The filing is a routine foreign private issuer report under the 1934 Act. This is an ordinary governance notice with no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or abrupt management change.
